story: Gulf State Park is a public recreation area located on the Gulf of Mexico in Alabama, USA. Covering 6,150 acres, the park encompasses beaches, marshland, boggy tea-colored streams, pine forests, and three spring-fed, fresh-water lakes.
matters: The park provides habitats for various local species such as the white-tailed deer, bobcat, and osprey, while offering protected natural spaces along the coast of southern Baldwin County.
